headline: Congress approved appointing Franklin D. Raines as a citizen regent of the Smithsonian Institution's governing board.
what_it_does: This joint resolution names Franklin D. Raines as a citizen regent on the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution. The Board of Regents oversees the Smithsonian's museums and research centers. The measure is a formal appointment and does not create new rules, spending, or programs.
when_it_takes_effect: The resolution was enacted on October 2, 2020.
